summary: As the TeknoBirds team, we wrote a story about how important the space research vehicles sent to Mars are for humanity. Our goal was to show children in our own age group, ages 10 to 14, how important space exploration is. We chose to do this through a comic book.
details: In our project, we tried to show you how excited people are about Mars exploration, while also making it informative for the 10–14 age group. During this process, we used the Claude and Gemini tools.
